fields.product_id: Required non-empty string; unique within marketplace; not restricted to ASINs.
fields.title: Required non-empty string. Never generated or inferred.
fields.marketplace: Optional market or internal catalog name. Missing is unknown.
fields.price: Optional finite non-negative number. Requires currency.
fields.currency: Optional uppercase three-letter currency code. No currency conversion.
fields.rating: Optional finite non-negative number, no greater than rating_scale.
fields.rating_scale: Positive finite number, required with rating. No implicit five-point scale.
fields.review_count: Optional non-negative integer. Missing does not mean zero.
fields.source_url: Optional HTTP(S) URL without credentials or whitespace.
fields.observed_at: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone. Import time is recorded separately.

additionalFields: Preserved as extra metadata; no automatic header mapping.
errors: All invalid records are reported; no report is produced until input is corrected. CSV row numbers count logical records including the header; JSON rows are one-based array positions.
provenance: Keep the report and its .evidence directory together. It contains the exact input, input SHA-256, import time, source rows and normalized dataset. Missing source/time stays unknown.
samples: Bundled inputs are invented examples, not current market data.
offline: No authentication, network, or LLM call. Reports contain user data: review them before sharing. The optional Nexscope link opens a guide; it never refreshes data automatically.
